pullRequests.title: feat(cli): print the run's total cost in sail show's footer (FAKE-1)
pullRequests.body:
## Summary

`sail show` ends with the run's total cost.

## Demonstration

Surface: cli.

- `sail show <run>` ends with `total $<cost>`: a fake run of FAKE-1, then `sail show` on it.
- A run with no agent calls prints `total $0.00`: a one-script workflow, then `sail show`.

Closes FAKE-1
